def binary_search(arr, x):
    low, high = 0, len(arr)
    while low < high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if arr[mid] < x:
            low = mid + 1
        else:
            high = mid
    return low

        best_end = 0

            freq[arr[i] - 1] += 1
            freq[arr[i] + 1] += 1

            if freq[arr[i]] > max_len:

                best_start = i - max_len + 1

        current_circle.extend(height_indices[current_height])

        while True:
